paper.title: Crystal Statistics. I. A Two-Dimensional Model with an Order-Disorder Transition

headline: Ising 2D Glauber (agent-based): 3/3 locked clauses REPRO; measured |m|=0.5 crossing at T=2.335 (Onsager T_c≈2.269)

verdicts.gate: P1 ordered below T_c, disordered above (|m|>0.7 at T=1.5 AND |m|<0.2 at T=3.5)
P3 |m|(T) monotone non-increasing across the T-grid

extra.scope: faithful reproduction of a published synthetic model; no real-world data; the contribution is whether the harness + discipline reproduce the Onsager order-disorder transition and would catch an artifact. Finite L=32 rounds the transition (no sharp singularity at finite size).

citations: Onsager, L. (1944). Crystal Statistics. I. A Two-Dimensional Model with an Order-Disorder Transition. Phys. Rev. 65:117-149. doi:10.1103/PhysRev.65.117. Exact T_c = 2/ln(1+sqrt(2)) ≈ 2.269.
Glauber, R.J. (1963). Time-Dependent Statistics of the Ising Model. J. Math. Phys. 4:294-307. doi:10.1063/1.1703954.

benchmark.note: no cross-tool baseline; faithful single-implementation reproduction graded on the locked metric |magnetization|
